text: {"lessons":["The early swings and recent rebound are not reliable forecasts; I should base each decision on current risk and goals, not price patterns.","Selling A and B at gains while adding C, D, and E does not prove those choices were right; I should judge every holding by the same forward-looking criteria, not by my purchase price or reluctance to admit a mistake.","I mostly left the portfolio unchanged despite frequent checking; I should trade only when a deliberate review supports it, and rebalance for diversification rather than react to short-term moves."]}
